title: Voicelines Mod
description: this mod mod adds a menu when you press "Z". it has a lot of voicelines, like "happy", "angry", "crying", built-in minecraft voicelines and more.
body:
WARNING: THIS IS NOT A SERIOUS MOD, PURELY JUST FOR FUN AND FRIENDS :)

this mod mod adds a menu when you press "Z". it has around 12 sounds you can pick from

example of voicelines: happy, angry, crying, zombie, cave, and creeper (i regret this)

this will get a remake if atleast 1 person downloads it, making the mod 10x times better

mod made by ZeroCFrame
